changes: WP-10-camera_misc: five hardware domains in one work package. UVC cameras (VC/VS descriptors, probe/commit, MJPEG + YUY2 decode to RGB, 20 camera_* L1 interfaces); IEEE 1284 parallel port (SPP/EPP 1.7/1.9/ECP, 9 parallel_* interfaces); game port (0x201 timing, axes + 4 buttons + calibration, 7 gameport_* interfaces); infrared (CIR/SIR with NEC/RC5/RC6 encode + decode, 8 ir_* interfaces); SCSI (SAM/SPC over LSI 53C895A HBA, READ/WRITE/INQUIRY/READ CAPACITY, sda/sdb/sdc block devices with MBR/GPT, 7 scsi_* interfaces). 10 new shell commands (uvc, uvctest, parallel, paralleltest, gameport, gameporttest, ir, irtest, scsi, scsitest), 208 total; L1 interfaces 138 -> 189. OTA package carries the release kernel (build 193) + grub.cfg + opencube.conf + CONFIG.md.
